data.long_meaning: Geetleen is derived from the Sanskrit words 'geeta' meaning song, melody and 'leena' meaning rule, control. This name signifies a melodious and rule-abiding girl. The name Geetleen carries the meaning “Song, Melody” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Geetleen usually hope their child will grow to embody song, melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.
